source: I can’t bear my own reflection. Wearing the yellow belt and tassels of the Science Advisor of Aslandia. A mother soon, too. I should’ve been faster… Fungaki says I’m too hard on myself. But he’s just saying that because he loves me. The father of my little sprout. His imagination led us here. He dreamed of the possibility. I added my knowhow about fertilization and scientific method to chart the path towards a cure for Blue Death, which returned with the mosquitoes every summer. The mushroom paste antibiotic is not totally effective, a roughly 70% recovery rate – incredible, though, with our limited resources. I should’ve been faster… That… that snake… that scheming witch Seece and her Star Worshippers! They delayed our testing when they demanded to know what “poisons” we were brewing. Spreading lies and fear when the people needed hope. That brainwashed drunk Warek stormed in and smashed our grow-lab a year ago, setting us back months. I would’ve strangled Seece by now if it wasn’t for Fungaki. But I should’ve been faster… Dad. I should’ve made this antibiotic long ago – expanding the lab, testing more rapidly, ignoring tribal drama. I should’ve been ready for when you started wheezing… I miss you so much. My best friend. What do I do? Your grandchild will be amazing, just like you. I promise.

That’s why, when I was your age, I was obsessed with reading and learning and fixing. I thought that if I knew a little something about a lot of different ideas, then at least I’d have a direction to go and a place to start when I felt lost. Now I find myself more lost than ever, going into an

当你读到这封浸满泪水的信，我已随巨驳船离去，心中的快乐也全被掏空。我把整颗心留给你和爸爸。所有的爱，永远永远都属于你。

unknown direction, an unknown future. Just like you and Dad. 

How do we go on when we’re in the dark, when every step is unfamiliar? Well, I hum the lullaby I sang to you each night – you know it well: listen to my sound and turn your frown around, in the past we are found sayeth Quentin P. Brown. 

While we may not know where we’re headed, my love, take solace in the wonderful acts of your 12-year-old life. Recall the richness of your own history. No one can take away all the good you have spread. Wherever you choose to step, that direction is lit by who you are. Because of this, I know you’ll do amazing things, just like your parents and grandpa Gavin.

身处黑暗，每一步都陌生时，我们要怎么继续走？我会哼起每晚唱给你的摇篮曲，你很熟悉的那首：听我轻轻唱，眉头别紧皱；布朗说得好，过去把我们找到。

source: Herring Gull: I see this before… buttbiting seal hide, hide, hide in water. Then sploosh! Jump and eat swimming gull. These human act like seal… hide and want to hurt my mushroom friend…
target: 银鸥：我看过这个……咬屁股海豹躲、躲、躲在水里。然后噗通！跳出来，吃游泳的海鸥。这些人类像海豹……躲起来，要害我的蘑菇朋友……

source: Herring Gull: Got! Got piece! Ripped soft red leaf and I take – Ah!
target: 银鸥：拿到！拿到一片！撕下软软红叶子，我带走——啊！

source: Herring Gull: Aaaah! Close one – they shoot fast sticks. Stupid human buttbiters, hah!
target: 银鸥：啊——！好险，他们射快快的棍子。笨人类咬屁股怪，哈！

source: Herring Gull: Cruel humans not leave with big red floating nest? Why staying on rock island?
target: 银鸥：坏人类没跟红色大浮巢走？为什么留在石头岛？

source: Old Seagull: A-a-ack!
target: 老海鸥：啊、啊、嘎！

source: Old Seagull: Aa-acka!
target: 老海鸥：啊——嘎！

source: Fungaki: We owe you our lives, my feathery friend. Go ahead, gulp ‘em down the gullet, all the fish you like.
target: 芬加奇：羽毛朋友，我们欠你一条命。吃吧，通通吞下去，想吃多少鱼都行。

source: Old Seagull: Aaaa–ack!
target: 老海鸥：啊——嘎！

source: Old Seagull: Ackaaa!
target: 老海鸥：嘎啊！

source: Fungaki: You should’ve seen it, I rallied Aslandia – me, the fuel maker. We decided to use everything we had to take our stand. The men worked in the boats during the day, clumping large, sprawling patches of algae around the perimeter of the village. The women helped me cook barrels of my new, concentrated fuel. The children took all the fish, guts, and cooked blubber we had and mashed them together into a stinky paste you would’ve loved.
target: 芬加奇：你真该看看，我召集了整个阿斯兰迪亚——我，一个做燃料的。我们决定倾尽所有，奋力一搏。白天，男人们划船，把大片藻类聚到村子周围。女人们帮我熬制一桶桶新式浓缩燃料。孩子们则把我们所有的鱼、内脏和熟脂肪，捣成你一定会爱死的臭糊。

source: Fungaki: If you hadn’t brought me that shred of red silk two days ago, we would’ve been fish food. We thought Aryth’s goons were long gone after taking my world. My wife Daneve… wasn’t my world enough? I suppose they were waiting to strike, and we were foolish to trust their so-called “treaty.”
target: 芬加奇：要不是你两天前带来那片红丝绸，我们早就成鱼饲料了。我们以为，艾瑞丝的走狗夺走我的全世界后，就早已离去。我的妻子丹妮芙……我的全世界，还不够吗？看来他们一直等着下手，我们竟蠢到相信那份所谓的「条约」。

source: Fungaki: You’re right, old buddy – time to celebrate.
target: 芬加奇：你说得对，老朋友，该庆祝了。

source: Fungaki: We were ready when they attacked last night. As their boats approached, they slowed in the algae clumps and we lit ‘em up! You must’ve heard the two huge explosions… some sort of weapon to destroy our cement buildings I imagine. Their warriors jumped overboard into a feeding frenzy, and those who attempted to crawl out were met by our harpoons and knives. We didn’t lose a single life, can you believe it?
target: 芬加奇：昨晚他们进攻时，我们已准备好了。船一靠近，就被藻丛拖慢，我们立刻点火！你一定听见那两声巨响……我猜是某种用来炸毁水泥建筑的武器。他们的战士跳下船，掉进疯狂觅食的兽群，试图爬上岸的人，则迎上我们的鱼叉与刀。我们一个人也没死，你能相信吗？

source: Fungaki: During the night, the seal hunters would float out and soak my fuel into the algae, while the oystermen would chum the water with the fishy paste to draw in crocodiles and sharks and sea beasts of all sorts.
target: 芬加奇：夜里，海豹猎人漂出去，把我的燃料浸进藻丛。采蚝人则把那股鱼腥糊撒进水里，引来鳄鱼、鲨鱼，还有各式海兽。
